mr_title: Index resources in the UrlDispatcher to avoid linear search for most cases

expected_issues.title: Route index key keeps text before a variable in the same path segment
expected_issues.description:
The index key keeps the fixed text that precedes a variable in the same path segment (e.g. '/core/locations' for '/core/locations{tail:.*}'), but lookups walk the request path by whole '/' segments, so such routes are never found and return 404.

resolve() looks up candidate resources by progressively shorter prefixes of the request path cut at '/'. For a route like `/core/locations{tail:.*}` and a request `/core/locations-list`, the tried keys are `/core/locations-list`, `/core`, `/`, never `/core/locations`. The key must be truncated to the last '/' before the first '{' (here `/core`).
